title: AI Lens Technical Roadmap
goal: Create the repo-side AI Lens telemetry, projection and replay foundation so the sci-fi visualization is driven by real Odysseus runtime data.

problem_statement.user_need: The user wants a live view into the J-Space and the AI brain that feels animated and close to 1:1 reality.
problem_statement.current_gap: Odysseus has memory vectors, RAG, graph contracts, LLM stream helpers and tool execution surfaces, but no unified AI Lens event stream or semantic projection service.
problem_statement.technical_truth: API models do not expose true hidden neural state. AI Lens must show runtime trace and semantic projection for all models, then optionally show local-model internals only when a local runtime supports safe hooks.

research_evidence.repo_status_observed: dev branch contains unrelated dirty Frontpage/Planning changes and untracked roadmaps; AI Lens roadmap creation is docs-only and must not revert or touch those files.
existing_backend_sources: src/llm_stream_events.py contains SSE delta helpers and Harmony channel routing.
src/memory_vector.py provides Chroma-backed semantic memory search with similarity scores and embedding lanes.
src/progressive_graph_api.py defines bounded graph payload contracts and query/status types.
src/rag_manager.py, src/rag_vector.py and src/rag_text_chunking.py provide RAG indexing and retrieval foundations.
src/tool_execution.py and src/tool_result_formatting.py are likely integration points for tool-call telemetry.
src/ai_activity_ledger.py and src/llm_activity_metrics.py are likely places to align event accounting and metrics.
research_evidence.design_dependency: The technical roadmap owns what is true and observable; the design roadmap owns how it is rendered.

principles: Every emitted event must be tied to a real runtime observation or labeled as synthetic fixture data.
Raw prompts, private document bodies, secrets, tokens, chat IDs and raw provider output are forbidden in public Lens payloads.
Payloads use stable IDs, bounded previews, source refs and redaction levels.
High-frequency token or animation ticks are aggregated so AI Lens does not slow normal chat.
Insights summarize event evidence into user-relevant questions; they do not replace raw event trace for diagnostics.
Every insight must cite event_ids or source_refs that support it.
Insights use bounded counters, scores, labels and redacted previews rather than raw private content.
Low-confidence or incomplete insight calculations must say incomplete instead of inventing certainty.

event_models.goal: Provider-neutral dataclasses and validators for AI Lens events.
responsibilities: Normalize event types and truth levels.
Reject forbidden fields and overlarge payloads.
Support JSON serialization suitable for SSE or WebSocket.
Provide deterministic fixture events for frontend development.

service_layer.goal: A read-only service that collects recent events, builds snapshots and emits redacted streams.
responsibilities: Maintain per-session ring buffers.
Build current Lens snapshot payloads.
Expose /api/ai-lens/snapshot and /api/ai-lens/stream.
Throttle high-frequency event streams.
Provide fixture mode for UI work without live model calls.

instrumentation_hooks.goal: Emit events from existing Odysseus systems without coupling the core chat path to the UI.
responsibilities: Emit retrieval, context, model route, stream and tool events.
Never block answer generation if Lens capture fails.
Keep event previews redacted and bounded.
Attach source refs suitable for Context Transparency detail views.

jspace_projection.goal: Convert real embeddings and graph relations into stable 2D or 3D visualization coordinates.
responsibilities: Start with deterministic PCA-like projection or simple dimensional reduction that needs no new heavy dependency.
Preserve stable node placement across small updates where possible.
Return nodes, edges, clusters, scores and animation hints.
Label projection output as Semantic Projection, not neural internals.

context_graph_bridge.goal: Reuse Progressive Graph API conventions for bounded Memory, RAG, Tool and Session graph pages.
responsibilities: Represent query, memory, chunk, tool and answer nodes.
Represent similarity, citation, selected-for-context and tool-result edges.
Respect max nodes, max edges and payload budgets.
Provide graph slices for Orbit, Trace, Graph and Diagnostics modes.

insight_layer.goal: Derive compact, user-relevant information products from raw Lens events.
responsibilities: Build answer pack inventory, retrieval quality, source coverage, tool latency, confidence/risk and answer provenance summaries.
Reference supporting event IDs and source refs for every derived insight.
Expose incomplete or unavailable states explicitly.
Keep insight payloads bounded and safe for direct UI rendering.

replay_store.goal: Persist bounded AI Lens replay snapshots without raw private content.
responsibilities: Store event envelopes, projection coordinates and derived graph snapshots.
Allow replay of answer assembly without rerunning the model.
Expire or rotate snapshots based on privacy settings.
Avoid storing raw provider output or full private context.

local_model_microscope.goal: Optional local-only capture of sampled attention, logits or hidden-state metrics.
responsibilities: Remain disabled by default.
Advertise capability only when a local runtime supports safe hooks.
Sample rather than stream full tensors.
Expose truth_level local_model_internals with clear performance and privacy labels.

slice_queue.objective: Create this technical roadmap as a JSON planning source.
slice_queue.done_when: Roadmap exists as valid JSON and defines event, service, projection, graph, replay and local-model slices.

slice_queue.objective: Implement AI Lens event dataclasses, validators, redaction checks and fixture generation.
slice_queue.done_when: Events serialize to bounded JSON, reject forbidden fields and include truth_level labels.

slice_queue.objective: Add a read-only AI Lens service with per-session ring buffer, snapshot payload and fixture mode.
slice_queue.done_when: Service can ingest events, return current snapshot and bound event counts without UI dependencies.

slice_queue.objective: Expose snapshot and SSE stream routes behind existing auth and privacy boundaries.
slice_queue.done_when: /api/ai-lens/snapshot returns redacted fixture data and /api/ai-lens/stream emits bounded SSE events.

slice_queue.objective: Emit Memory and RAG search events with source refs, scores and redacted previews.
slice_queue.done_when: Memory/RAG retrieval can emit memory_hit and rag_hit events without exposing raw private content.

slice_queue.objective: Emit model route, streaming and tool-call events from the chat and tool execution path.
slice_queue.done_when: Model and tool events appear in Lens trace while normal chat continues if Lens capture is disabled or fails.

slice_queue.objective: Build deterministic Semantic Projection from query, memory, RAG and tool evidence vectors or scores.
slice_queue.done_when: Projection returns stable nodes, coordinates, clusters and edges from deterministic fixtures.

slice_queue.objective: Expose a bounded graph page for Lens Orbit, Trace, Graph and Diagnostics modes.
slice_queue.done_when: Graph payloads enforce node/edge budgets and distinguish query, memory, RAG, tool and answer nodes.

slice_queue.objective: Persist bounded AI Lens replay snapshots for recent answers.
slice_queue.done_when: Replay snapshots can be saved, loaded and expired without raw private content.

slice_queue.objective: Derive information products from raw events so AI Lens highlights useful answers, not just telemetry.
slice_queue.done_when: Snapshots include answer pack inventory, retrieval quality, source coverage, tool latency, confidence/risk and answer provenance summaries with supporting refs.

slice_queue.objective: Implement a pure disabled-by-default capability and sampling-envelope contract for optional local-model internals without importing or starting a model runtime.
forbidden_actions: import, load or start a model runtime
capture prompts, completions, provider output or tensors
read GPU, model or host runtime state
network, provider, database, filesystem artifact or UI mutation
slice_queue.done_when: A pure contract reports unavailable/disabled by default, validates bounded aggregate-only sample envelopes, rejects raw tensors or private fields and cannot perform runtime I/O.

slice_queue.objective: Run one bounded aggregate-only sampling smoke against an explicitly selected supported local runtime.
slice_queue.done_when: One selected local runtime returns only bounded aggregate metrics under declared sample, duration, retention and performance limits, with no raw prompt, completion, tensor or private context in evidence.

blocks: manual live SSE smoke with real provider streams
gate_queue.decision_needed: Operator allows a bounded live chat run for Lens telemetry observation.
gate_queue.safe_preparation_done: Fixture route and unit tests can be built without live provider calls.
gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: Private provider output or unstable live failures could be captured without review.

gate_queue.decision_needed: Select the exact local model runtime plus sample count, duration, aggregate metrics, performance budget, retention and redacted evidence path.
gate_queue.safe_preparation_done: AIL-TECH-9A may implement and test only the pure disabled-by-default capability and aggregate-envelope contract without runtime imports or I/O.
gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: Performance degradation, GPU memory pressure or misleading hidden-state visuals.

manual_smoke_requires_go: Live chat emits Lens events while answer streaming remains responsive.
AI Lens stream does not include raw private content or full prompts.
Local-model internals appear only for an explicitly allowed local model runtime.

go_language.go: AI Lens runtime trace, semantic projection, graph and replay work from bounded redacted events and have focused tests.
go_language.partial: Fixture-backed and read-only live trace work, but replay or local-model internals remain deferred.
go_language.deferred: Live provider smoke and local-model internals wait for explicit operator Go.
go_language.no_go: Telemetry exposes raw secrets/private content, blocks normal chat, fabricates neural internals or starts live model hooks without consent.
go_language.blocked: No stable event contract or no safe way to bound/redact Lens payloads.

recommended_next_step: Complete AIL-TECH-9A as a pure offline capability contract; keep AIL-TECH-9B blocked until the operator supplies the exact local runtime and bounded live-sampling policy.
